title: Rhythm & Rust
logline: A shy, rusty robot overcomes its social anxiety on a neon-lit rooftop party after a vibrant dance-bot teaches it how to groove.
theme: Overcoming self-doubt and finding joy in self-expression.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A shy, slightly rusty metallic robot with expressive blue LED eyes who feels out of place at parties.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: An energetic, sleek dance-bot covered in colorful neon strips who loves sharing the joy of movement.

scenes.title: The Wallflower
scenes.summary: Bolt stands nervously behind a potted palm tree on a crowded, neon-lit rooftop party, watching other robots dance flawlessly.

scenes.title: An Invitation
scenes.summary: Spark spots Bolt hiding, glides over with a warm smile, and extends a hand, performing a simple, inviting side-step rhythm.

scenes.title: First Clunky Steps
scenes.summary: Bolt hesitantly tries to mimic Spark's move, gears grinding loudly as it stumbles. Spark laughs gently and claps, encouraging Bolt to try again.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: Bolt relaxes. Its joints loosen up, and its LED eyes change from anxious blue to a warm, pulsing yellow as it starts to sync with Spark's rhythm.

scenes.title: Rooftop Royalty
scenes.summary: The surrounding crowd of robots gathers around to cheer as Bolt executes a triumphant, perfectly-timed spin-and-pose alongside Spark.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
